<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[International military intervention against ISIL]], [[Battle of Baghuz Fawqani]]
**[[Syrian Democratic Forces]] declares progress in [[Syria]] after an [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] camp on the outskirts of [[Al-Baghuz Fawqani|Baghouz]] is captured. [https://www.npr.org/2019/03/19/704730563/isis-camp-in-baghouz-is-captured-as-u-s-allies-celebrate-progress-in-syria (NPR)] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/isis-fighters-tied-to-killing-4-americans-in-syria-captured-by-us-backed-fighters-us-official-says (Fox News)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] awards this year’s [[Abel Prize]] to [[Karen Uhlenbeck]]  for “her pioneering achievements in geometric partial differential equations, gauge theory and integrable systems."  Uhlenbeck is the first woman to win this prize. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/karen-uhlenbeck-is-first-woman-to-receive-abel-prize-in-mathematics/ar-BBUXk35 (''The new York Times'' via MSN.com)]

;International relations 
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] express interest in jointly hosting the [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-soccer-women-worldcup-2023/south-and-north-korea-seek-womens-world-cup-in-latest-detente-idUKKCN1R01C3 (Reuters UK)] [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20190319009900315?section=sports/sports (Yonhap News Agency)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[President of Kazakhstan]], [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]], announces his resignation after 29 years in office. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kazakhstan-president/president-of-kazakhstan-nursultan-nazarbayev-resigns-idUSKCN1R01N1 (Reuters)]

*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**A judge issued an arrest warrant against the presidential candidate [[Thelma Aldana]] however, the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] registered Aldana as a presidential candidate so she enjoys immunity and can not be arrested. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/thelma-aldana-ya-esta-inscrita-como-candidata-presidencial/ ''(Prensa Libre)'']

;Sports
*[[Mike Trout]] and the [[Los Angeles Angels]] finalize a record-breaking 12-year, $430 million contract, the largest in the history of [[Major League Baseball]]. [https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2826558-report-mike-trout-angels-finalizing-historic-12-year-430m-contract (Bleacher Report)]
